name: Watch Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a red smartwatch whose round screen shows Rotom's lens eyes and smile, with peach buttons and a looped strap
entry: It counts its Trainer's steps and buzzes when they sit still too long. It always knows what time it will be.
how: Use a Watch Strap on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Future Sight in this form.
